create_BailingLinearMetadata: create a BailingLinearMetadata instance with batch_size, q_lengths, and mamba cache indices for decode-only inference
build_prepare_decode: build BailingLinearMetadata for CUDA graph decode-only path using query_start_loc, mamba_cache_indices, batch size, and seq_lens
build_prepare_mixed: build BailingLinearMetadata for mixed prefill-and-decode batch using query_start_loc, mamba_cache_indices, and ForwardBatch
test_prepare_decode: test prepare_decode returns BailingLinearMetadata with num_prefills=0 and num_prefill_tokens=0 for decode-only path
test_prepare_mixed: test prepare_mixed delegates to prepare_decode when extend_num_tokens is None and computes prefill/decode counts otherwise
